title: a new table from its Template

phases.job: Make a new table of your own, mart_dev.runs_per_day, with the Toolbox: one row per job and day of ops.job_runs, for 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24, with job_id, runs (how many runs that job had that day) and dt, partitioned by dt. Write its logic yourself, then write the table. Your Dev Database is mart_dev, and your Prod Database is team_prod. Each new table you make goes in the folder /data/team/<its database>.db/<its name>, such as /data/team/mart_dev.db/weekly; a table someone else made stays where it is.
